summary: Linkers Industries Ltd filed Form 6-K to disclose that it has been named as one of numerous issuer defendants in three putative securities class actions filed in New York Supreme Court (Johnson, Briones, and Morales actions). The lawsuits allege violations of Sections 11, 12(a)(2), and 15 of the Securities Act related to alleged market manipulation in nano-cap and micro-cap IPOs, without specific allegations against the Company. The Company has not been served in two actions, has been served in one, and intends to seek dismissal and vigorously defend. This is a routine litigation disclosure, not a special situation.
